notes: Read all 298 source lines before editing. Imports (L1-8): React useState/useMemo (L1) kept and extended with useCallback (i18n shim) + ReactNode (inlined component typing); react-i18next useTranslation (L2) -> a local useTranslation() returning the English fallback with a stable useCallback identity so the `tabs` useMemo [t] dep stays honest; the lucide Clock/FileJson/Zap glyphs (L3) -> the shared native SemanticIcon (clock/fileJson/bolt, decorative); the shared web Modal/Button/Select/Textarea/Tabs (L5-6) -> the already-ported native Tabs + inlined native Modal(Dialog)/Button/Select/Textarea; TOUSettingsPayload/TOUPreset (L8) imported from the ported api/hooks/useEnergy (which consolidates @/types/energy). useUpdateTOUSettings + useRefreshTeslaEnergySiteInfo (L7) imported from the same ported hook file.

PRESETS (L10-125): all three California TOU presets — PG&E EV2-A (L13-48), SCE TOU-D (L49-88), SDG&E TOU-DR1 (L89-124) — ported byte-for-byte, including id/name/utility, tou_settings.optimization_strategy 'economics', tariff_content_v2 name/utility, daily_charges amounts (0.32854 / 0.031 / 0.546), demand_charges {ALL:{ALL:0}}, the full Summer/Winter ON_PEAK/MID_PEAK/OFF_PEAK/SUPER_OFF_PEAK rate/start/end arrays, and the seasons fromMonth/fromDay/toMonth/toDay. Typed as TOUPreset[] exactly as the source.

TOUSettingsModalProps (L129-133) ported field-for-field: open, onClose, siteId:number. Component signature + destructure (L135) preserved. Hooks (L136-138): const {t}=useTranslation(); useUpdateTOUSettings() -> updateMutation; useRefreshTeslaEnergySiteInfo() -> refreshSiteInfo. State (L140-143) preserved verbatim with identical names + seeds: activeTab:string='preset', selectedPreset='', customJSON='', error=''.

presetOptions useMemo (L145-148) ported verbatim: PRESETS.map(p => ({value: p.id, label: `${p.name} — ${p.utility}`})), [] deps. tabs useMemo (L150-156) ported verbatim with the same keys/labels (energy.tou.tabPreset 'Preset Tariff', energy.tou.tabCustom 'Custom JSON') and [t] deps honoured by the stable shim.

getPayload() (L158-192) ported verbatim: setError('') first; preset branch finds PRESETS by selectedPreset -> error energy.tou.errorNoPreset 'Please select a rate plan' + null when missing, else preset.settings; custom branch trims customJSON -> energy.tou.errorEmptyJSON 'Please enter the TOU settings JSON' when empty; JSON.parse -> non-object/null/array guard -> energy.tou.errorNotObject 'JSON must be an object'; 'tou_settings' in obj -> return as TOUSettingsPayload, else wrap as {tou_settings: obj}; catch -> energy.tou.errorInvalidJSON 'Invalid JSON — please check syntax'. Same comments preserved.

handleSubmit() (L194-211) ported verbatim: getPayload() guard; updateMutation.mutate({siteId, settings: payload}, {onSuccess: refreshSiteInfo.mutate(siteId) + onClose() (with the same site-info refresh comment), onError: setError(String(err instanceof Error ? err.message : err))}). handleClose() (L213-218) ported verbatim: guarded on !updateMutation.isPending -> setError('') + onClose().

JSX (L220-298) ported section-by-section. Shared (L221) -> inlined native Dialog (centered RNModal, backdrop Pressable -> handleClose, header title + close glyph, ScrollView body; size 'lg' -> maxWidth 672). space-y-4 (L222) -> stack View (gap md). Description

(L223-228) -> AppText description style. (L230) -> native Tabs, same props. Preset tab (L232-251): space-y-3 -> tabBody;
Custom tab (L252-270): space-y-3 -> tabBody;

Footer (L278-294): flex justify-end gap-2 pt-2 -> footerRow View; Button variant='ghost' onClick=handleClose disabled={isPending} Cancel (common.cancel) -> native Button variant='ghost' onPress=handleClose; Button onClick=handleSubmit loading={isPending} disabled={isPending} with <Clock/> + energy.tou.submit 'Update Rate Plan' -> native primary Button onPress=handleSubmit loading/disabled with icon={SemanticIcon clock}. Closing tags + brace (L295-298) reproduced.

Native-safe substitutions: shared <Modal> createPortal + DOM focus trap / Escape / Tab cycling -> RNModal animationType='fade' transparent (backdrop Pressable -> onClose, onRequestClose -> onClose) with accessibilityViewIsModal + aria-label; size presets sm/md/lg/full -> maxWidth 384/512/672/1100; focus trap + Tab cycling dropped (no RN DOM model). Shared <Select> DOM <select>/<option> -> Pressable trigger + Modal option sheet (FleetApiSection precedent); the placeholder <option value=''> is preserved as a selectable first row so re-selecting it resets to '' and hides the preview, exactly like the web. Shared <Textarea> -> multiline TextInput with focus accent border + monospace font. Shared <Button> animated SVG spinner -> ActivityIndicator; primary/ghost tones; disabled||loading both block onPress (web disabled={disabled||loading}). lucide Clock/FileJson/Zap -> SemanticIcon clock/fileJson/bolt (Zap->bolt matches GasPriceAutoPollPage).

No DOM elements, react-dom, lucide-react, framer-motion, Recharts, Leaflet, or web UI-kit modules are imported into the native output — only React, RN primitives (ActivityIndicator/Modal/Platform/Pressable/ScrollView/TextInput/View/StyleSheet), the ported useEnergy hooks+types, the shared native Tabs/AppText/SemanticIcon, and theme tokens (colors/spacing). Verified with `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint -- --quiet`, and `npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles` (added __tests__/TOUSettingsModal.test.tsx covering the two tabs, the empty-preset and invalid-JSON error gating, the preset preview rendering, the happy-path submit firing useUpdateTOUSettings with {siteId, settings} + the site-info refresh, and Cancel -> onClose).
